camel_example: aliyun devops GET /organization/5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx/workitems/fields/listAll --region cn-hangzhou --spaceType Project --spaceIdentifier e8bxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx23 --workitemTypeIdentifier dfexxxxxf4fee18xxxxx36 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Retrieve the list of work item fields
name: ListWorkItemAllFields

parameters.help_en: Organization identifier, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: UUID of the project, equivalent to projectId
parameters.help_zh: 项目唯一标识id，同projectId，项目唯一标识
parameters.name: space_identifier

parameters.help_en: Work item type ID. The list of work item types and their IDs can be retrieved from ListProjectWorkitemTypes
parameters.help_zh: 工作项类型id，工作项类型的列表和ID可以从ListProjectWorkitemTypes中获取
parameters.name: workitem_type_identifier
